name: @w6w-apps/sierrainteractive
description: Leads, notes, tasks, saved listings, showing requests and action plans in Sierra Interactive.

w6w.longDescription:
Sierra Interactive is a real-estate CRM and website platform: it captures leads from IDX search sites, assigns them to agents, tracks their saved searches and listings, and runs action plans (drip sequences) on them.

This app lets a workflow push and pull that data. Create or update a lead from a form, an ad or another CRM; find a lead by email; add a note or a follow-up task; record a saved listing, a request for information or a showing request; apply or stop a traditional or fully automated action plan; and read the reference lists (agents, sites, lead sources, statuses, tags, MLS regions, action plans) needed to fill those requests in correctly.

A Sierra API key is the only credential. It covers the Zapier-facing integration surface that Sierra publishes in its Swagger document.
